nodes.name: ChannelDataMapper.java
nodes.summary: MyBatis-Plus mapper interface for the channel_data table, providing database access for channel configuration data.

nodes.name: ChannelDataMapper
nodes.summary: MyBatis-Plus BaseMapper interface for ChannelTableData entity persistence operations.

nodes.name: ChannelDataService.java
nodes.summary: Service in the base-data service that queries and adds channel data, writing new channel records to MySQL and caching them in Redis.

nodes.name: ChannelDataService
nodes.summary: Spring service managing channel data CRUD with MyBatis-Plus mapper and Redis cache write-through.

nodes.name: getByCode
nodes.summary: Queries an active channel data record by code via MyBatis-Plus and maps it to GetChannelDataVo.

nodes.name: add
nodes.summary: Inserts a new channel data record with a UID-generated id and refreshes the Redis cache entry.

nodes.name: RequestValidationFilter.java
nodes.summary: Core gateway global filter that rate-limits requests, reads and reassembles request bodies, verifies RSA signatures and encryption, validates tokens, and enforces API restriction rules before routing.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Spring WebFlux reactive types (Mono, ServerWebExchange) with request decorator pattern for body re-reading.

nodes.name: RequestValidationFilter
nodes.summary: Global gateway filter orchestrating rate limiting, request body decryption, signature verification, token checks, and API restriction enforcement.

nodes.name: filter
nodes.summary: Entry point of the filter that acquires a rate limiter permit when the rate switch is on, then delegates to doFilter.

nodes.name: doFilter
nodes.summary: Extracts trace and channel headers, populates BaseParameterHolder and MDC, and branches into body reading for JSON requests or direct execution.

nodes.name: readBody
nodes.summary: Reactively reads the request body string, executes validation, and rebuilds the request with decorated headers and cached body.

nodes.name: execute
nodes.summary: Runs validation on the request body and stashes validated parameters into the request wrapper map.

nodes.name: doExecute
nodes.summary: Performs the full request validation pipeline: access-mode check, parameter verification, V2 RSA decryption and signature check, token validation, user id injection, and API restriction invocation.

nodes.name: decorateHead
nodes.summary: Builds a ServerHttpRequestDecorator that rewrites headers, restores validated parameters as headers, and replays the cached request body.

nodes.name: skipCheckToken
nodes.summary: Determines whether the request URL matches configured token-check paths using Ant path matching.

nodes.name: skipCheckParameter
nodes.summary: Determines whether the request URL matches configured parameter-check skip paths using Ant path matching.

nodes.name: checkNeedUserId
nodes.summary: Checks whether the request URL requires a user id by matching against configured user-id paths.

nodes.name: ResponseValidationFilter.java
nodes.summary: Gateway global filter that decorates responses and RSA-encrypts the response payload for V2 channel requests before writing back to the client.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses ServerHttpResponseDecorator with reactive body rewriting via BodyInserters and CachedBodyOutputMessage.

nodes.name: ResponseValidationFilter
nodes.summary: Global gateway filter decorating the HTTP response to encrypt response data for verified V2 channel requests.

nodes.name: decorate
nodes.summary: Creates a ServerHttpResponseDecorator that buffers the response body, applies response-body modification, and rewrites content length headers.

nodes.name: checkResponseBody
nodes.summary: For verified V2 requests, encrypts the ApiResponse data field with the channel's RSA data public key.

nodes.name: RateLimiter.java
nodes.summary: Semaphore-based rate limiter used by the gateway to bound concurrent request throughput.

nodes.name: RateLimiter
nodes.summary: Lightweight rate limiter wrapping a Semaphore with acquire/release and a max permits per second configuration.

nodes.name: RateLimiterProperty.java
nodes.summary: Configuration properties for the gateway rate limiter: on/off switch and permits count.

nodes.name: RateLimiterProperty
nodes.summary: Spring configuration properties bean holding the rate limiter switch and permit count.

nodes.name: GatewayProperty.java
nodes.summary: Gateway configuration properties defining API restriction paths, token check paths, parameter skip paths, normal access flag, and user id paths.

nodes.name: GatewayProperty
nodes.summary: Configuration properties bean aggregating gateway path lists and access-control flags.

nodes.name: ApiRestrictService.java
nodes.summary: Gateway service enforcing API call restriction rules (plain and depth/time-window rules) via Redis-backed Lua operations, and reporting API call data through Kafka.

nodes.name: ApiRestrictService
nodes.summary: Service that loads restriction rules from Redis, builds rule parameters, executes Lua-based limiting, and records triggered API call statistics.

nodes.name: checkApiRestrict
nodes.summary: Matches the request URI against configured API restriction paths to decide whether restriction applies.

nodes.name: apiRestrict
nodes.summary: Core restriction logic: builds the limit key, loads rule and depth-rule data from Redis, executes the Lua rule operation, and throws when the threshold is triggered.

nodes.name: getRuleParameter
nodes.summary: Assembles the parameter payload for a plain restriction rule, including stat/effective time, threshold, and Redis keys.

nodes.name: getDepthRuleParameter
nodes.summary: Assembles parameters for depth (multi time-window) restriction rules, sorting windows and building per-level rule entries.

nodes.name: getIpAddress
nodes.summary: Resolves the real client IP address from proxy headers (X-Forwarded-For and friends) falling back to the remote address.

nodes.name: saveApiData
nodes.summary: Builds an ApiDataDto with call timestamps at multiple granularities and sends it via Kafka message producer.

nodes.name: ChannelDataService.java
nodes.summary: Gateway-side channel data service that resolves channel configuration from Redis cache, falling back to an async Feign call to the base-data service.

nodes.name: ChannelDataService
nodes.summary: Service resolving channel data with Redis-first lookup and thread-pool-backed remote fallback via BaseDataClient.

nodes.name: checkCode
nodes.summary: Validates that the channel code argument is non-empty, raising an ArgumentException otherwise.

nodes.name: getChannelDataByCode
nodes.summary: Returns channel data from Redis cache, falling back to remote fetch and populating the cache on miss.

nodes.name: getChannelDataByClient
nodes.summary: Fetches channel data remotely by submitting a Feign call to a thread pool and unwrapping the ApiResponse with error handling.
